tracking.observation: Mean power was close to the interval-end reference.
tracking.check: Watch whether the gap opens up.

shortfall.observation: Mean power was well below the interval-end reference.
shortfall.check: Check wind availability, dispatch limits and controller state.

generating.observation: Power output, generator speed and recorded running time indicate generation.
generating.check: Confirm live availability before scheduling output.

idle.observation: Low power and generator speed accompanied an absence of recorded running time.
idle.check: Check the live controller state for the reason it is idle.

warming.observation: All generator winding temperatures rose over the latest hour.
warming.check: Check load and cooling if warming continues.

cooling.observation: All generator winding temperatures fell over the latest hour.
cooling.check: Check recent load and live limits before changing output.

small spread.observation: The phase-current averages were close together at cutoff.
small spread.check: Check live protection if it flags an issue.

wide spread.observation: The phase-current averages were widely separated at cutoff.
wide spread.check: Compare live phase measurements with independent metering.

reporting.observation: Power, wind, generator speed and running time all reported at cutoff.
reporting.check: Use the readings to assess operation.

missing.observation: None of the selected channels reported at cutoff.

error present.observation: The error flag was active at cutoff and in earlier readings.
error present.check: Retrieve the first-out alarm and event sequence.

no error recorded.observation: The error flag stayed inactive throughout the window.
no error recorded.check: Check live status if a fault remains suspected.
